WITH mix_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, '(missing)') AS mix, COUNT(*) AS mix_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  GROUP BY COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, '(missing)')
), shares AS (
  SELECT mix, mix_count, 1.0 * mix_count / SUM(mix_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM mix_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT mix, mix_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT mix, mix_count AS count, share, share - avg_share AS above_average_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > avg_share;
